summary.text: Jim Burgin is a Republican member of the North Carolina State Senate who has represented District 12 since January 1, 2019, and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as business executive.

paragraphs.text: Burgin was born in Knoxville, Tennessee, and earned a bachelor's degree in business administration from the University of Tennessee at Knoxville.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as including serving as president and owner of C&D Insurance and as president of B.C. Property Inc.
Burgin succeeded Ronald Rabin, a fellow Republican, in the Senate.

For the 2025-2026 session, Ballotpedia lists him as chair of the Appropriations on Health and Human Services Committee and the Health Care Committee, and a member of the Agriculture, Energy, and Environment, Appropriations/Base Budget, Finance, Pensions and Retirement and Aging, and State and Local Government committees.
